description: This file contains automated UI tests for the calculator application's history panel and flyout, verifying history item selection, clearing history, and UI behavior using the MSTest framework and Selenium WebDriver.

classes.name: HistoryFunctionalTests
classes.description: Contains UI test methods for verifying calculator history panel and flyout functionality.

methods.name: ClassInitialize
methods.description: Sets up the calculator session and prepares the calculator UI for testing.

methods.name: ClassCleanup
methods.description: Tears down the calculator session after tests are completed.

methods.name: TestInit
methods.description: Initializes the calculator to a known state before each test.

methods.name: TestCleanup
methods.description: Resets the calculator state after each test.

methods.name: StandardHistory_Panel
methods.description: Automated test verifying history panel item selection, expression correctness, and clearing history.

methods.name: StandardHistory_Flyout
methods.description: Automated test verifying history flyout item selection, synchronization with history panel, and clearing history.
